name: Barlow For Wyo
subject: Barlow For Wyoming Newsletter
body:
Election Day
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| **ALL IN**
---
| Hi Friends,Kelly and I have been talking about all the people we’ve met and the places we’ve been since August. It’s hard to believe we’re down to the last day of the campaign. We’re grateful, we’re excited, and we’re ready.You’ve welcomed us into your communities, shared meals with us, and stayed to visit long after an event was over. You’ve asked hard questions and trusted us with concerns about your families, your livelihoods, and your towns. We’ve learned a lot, and we’ll carry those conversations into the work ahead.There’s a lot of hope in Wyoming. We’ve heard it from young people wanting to build their lives here and from folks who have spent a lifetime making their communities better. People want to help. That gives Kelly and me a great deal of confidence in what we can accomplish together.First, let’s win this election.As I have said since day one, I am running for Wyoming, not against anyone. If you’ve already voted, thank you. If you haven’t, make today count for elections across our state, counties, and towns. Call your friends and check with your neighbors. We’ve worked too hard to take anything for granted. Let’s see it through.To our volunteers, staff, and advisors, thank you. You’ve given up evenings and weekends, put miles on your vehicles, and handled more details than anyone could count. Kelly and I know how much you’ve put into this.Most of all, thank you to the voters who got us here. We asked for your prayers, your money, and your votes. You kept showing up. You brought friends, put up signs, spoke on our behalf, and told us what you want for Wyoming. We’re proud to have earned your support, and we intend to honor it with our work.Please keep Wyoming in your prayers as we finish this election and, with your vote, take on the responsibility ahead. It means a great deal to have you with us.Let’s finish this, Wyoming. Then let’s get to work.Stay strong. Stay WyomingEric
---
| **ELECTION DAY MESSAGE FROM ERIC**
---
| | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_1)
---
|
---
| ELECTION NIGHT VIDEO CALL
Join us TONIGHT from 7:30-8:00 pm for an election night message from Eric and Kelly, as well as other statewide Republican nominees!
---
| | |
1. Join by video via Google Meet by clicking [**here**](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_2)
2. Dial in by phone at 323.741.1778 (Pin 676 690 620#)
3. Or, through this QR code->

---
| | |
---
| **WHAT'S NEXT?**
---
| **CAMPAIGN SIGN MANAGEMENT** As the campaign concludes, it is time to take down the Barlow for Governor signs. I appreciate each of you for putting them up and showing your support all this time. If you want to keep them, please do. The yard signs and thinner 4x4 and 4x8 signs will need to go into the garbage or could be used for sledding this winter! If you have one of the 4x4 or 4x8 thicker signs and it is in good shape, feel free to contact the campaign at scheduler@barlowforwyo.com, and we can make a plan to get them into storage for next time.
---
|
---
| **TRANSITION** If we are successful today, there will be an official transition website and office. Details will be available on the campaign website. My administration will need capable people who are ready to serve Wyoming.I will be looking for individuals who are respectful, listen and follow through. If you are interested in serving or know someone who is, please keep an eye out for the official website.
---
|
---
| **HEALTHCARE STRIKE TEAM** We're fast at work on healthcare solutions for Wyoming.Those who have signed up for the healthcare strike team effort will receive an email later this week about how to continue to help on Day One recommendations to share with Eric and the team.If you haven't signed up yet, please access the link below.
---
| | [ ACCESS HEALTHCARE STRIKE TEAM ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_3)
---
| **IN THE NEWS**
---
| | | **GILLETTE NEWS RECORD**[ Barlow Responds to Opponent's Criticisms on Legislative Record, State Government](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_4)[A Time for Choosing - Hallinan](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_5)**WYOFILE**[ Barlow laps Bextel on fundraising in Wyoming governor’s race with $2M](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_6)**NACOINALE**[Wyoming governor’s race: Eric Barlow, who beat Trump’s pick in the primary, faces Casner and Bextel](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_7)
---
| **WYOMING PUBLIC MEDIA**[ Gordon Endorses Barlow as Election as Election Nears](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_8)**WYOMING NEWS**[ Wyoming Congressional Delegates Endorse Barlow and Gray](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_9)**COWBOY STATE DAILY**[Rod Miller: Eric Barlow’s Ground Game](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M6GYB12NJK3M23Z3HERSAAR3_10)
---
|
---
| **ENDORSEMENTS**
---
| | | **CAMPAIGN ENDORSEMENTS**
* Governor Mark Gordon
* U.S. Senator John Barrasso
* U.S. Senator Cynthia Lummis
* U.S. Representative Harriet Hageman
* Petroleum Association of Wyoming
* Wyoming Hospitality &Travel Coalition
* Wyoming Realtors PAC
* Federated Fire Firefighters of Wyoming
* Wyoming Retirees
* Wyoming Neighbors For Housing
* Associated General Contractors of Wyoming
* WY Credit Unions
* Wyoming Dental Association
* Wyoming Bankers Association
* Protect Wyoming
* AFL-CIO Wyoming
* Wyoming Coalition for a Healthy Retirement
* Common Sense Republicans for Wyoming
* Wyoming Sportsman for Federal Lands
* NRA
* Center for Effective Lawmaking
* Wyoming Stockgrowers
* Northeast Realtors Alliance
* Cheyenne Firefighters PAC
* Wyoming Fire Chief's Association
* Mental Health PAC
* Farmers Union Rural PAC

---
| | |
---
| **On The Trail**
---
| **GILLETTE** I joined student leaders from across Wyoming at Gillette College for the Wyoming Student Government Conference. We visited about leadership, serving our communities and helping others find their way.Student government gives young people a chance to listen to their peers, take on responsibility and work through disagreements. Those are skills our communities need, and I appreciate these students stepping up.Thank you to Student Senate President Josh Rogers and Gillette College for the invitation.
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| **CHEYENNE** Appreciated the opportunity to meet with Tallgrass leadership and learn more about their operations across Wyoming, including new development south of Cheyenne. We also got a look inside their pipeline operations room. Always good to see firsthand the work happening across our state.
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **LARAMIE** One of the highlights of this campaign has been connecting with Wyoming students and young professionals who care about our state’s future.I enjoyed speaking at the ASUW Gubernatorial Forum in September and appreciated Ellu, a 19-year-old UW student, volunteering to share our message at the recent Albany County candidate forum hosted by ASUW, the UW Faculty Senate and UW Staff Senate.Over the past 14 months, we’ve heard from young people across Wyoming about their ideas, priorities and hopes for our state. Their enthusiasm and willingness to get involved have been encouraging.I’m grateful to everyone who has been part of those conversations. Wyoming’s future is bright!
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| **CHEYENNE** Thanks to Boris, Mario and Noah with the Western States Regional Council of Carpenters. We talked about apprenticeships, partnerships with higher education and opportunities for young people to build careers in the trades. These are the folks helping build Wyoming’s economy, and I appreciate the work they do.
---
|
---
| **GILLETTE** Good morning from Gillette, where firefighters from across Wyoming are gathering for the Leadership 7220 conference! It was an honor to hear from folks who do so much to keep our communities safe. Thank you for your service and dedication to Wyoming.
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **CHEYENNE** Thanks to the Wyoming Taxpayers Association and Hank Halverson for inviting me to speak at its annual meeting in Cheyenne about Wyoming’s fiscal outlook.We had good discussions on road funding, legacy assets, workforce, data centers, tax policy and what’s ahead for the Legislature.These are smart, hardworking business owners who have a lot invested in Wyoming’s future. I appreciated hearing their questions and ideas.
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | | |
---
| **CHEYENNE** Good conversations with the Wyoming Rural Electric Association and electric cooperatives from across the state about keeping Wyoming powered today and into the future. Our co-ops play an important role in communities all across Wyoming, especially in our rural areas.
---
|
---

body:
Get Out to Vote.
Peter,
The day we’ve all been working so hard towards is finally here, and there’s only one final thing to say: **Get Out to Vote.**
Making your voice heard is an integral part of how our democracy works, and it would be a disservice to not include yours in one of the most important elections we’ve had.
This is your moment to remember how you felt these past 2 years:
All those moments where you drove past the gas station with wide eyes at how high the prices have gotten, and then still had to pull in because how else would your kids get to school the next day?
All those moments you felt unseen and unheard in spaces that should include you.
Those feelings are important.
Those memories are vital.
Because those are what get us to the polls today.
With Gratitude,
April McClain Delaney

| | | We finally made it, Team -- It's Election Day! We've spent a long two years watching opponents of voting rights run roughshod over our government and our democracy and now it's time for voters to let them know how we feel about it.

There's a lot on the line in today's elections, from the House and Senate to state legislatures, governors, Secretaries of State, and Attorneys General down to your local offices around the country. Voting rights and ballot access are 100% on the ballot, especially in the wake of extreme gerrymandering and the Supreme Court dismantling the VRA. Here's how you can get over the finish line:
---
* If you have not voted yet, **make sure you do your part and vote!**

* Once you're in line, no matter what, **stay in line**. Bring water, bring snacks, do everything you can to cast your ballot

* If you filled in a mail-in ballot and have not sent it yet, don't go to the Post Office. **Take your ballot to a local drop box** or **drop it off by hand at your local polling place**.
* If you have any questions about where to vote, if you're still registered, or how to contact elections officials, please [**use our voter tools to find out what you need to know**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142817312/658150126/1044253134?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIwYTk0YTVmLTk3ZDctZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTU0NDQyZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pHf1kAJYN2WmusUsJOr-60zwTdxptEtN33fLa9pWV88=&emci=51f62a04-92d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&emdi=b0a94a5f-97d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&ceid=33603084).
* If you have any problems voting, reach out to the national, nonpartisan **[Lawyers’ Committee for Civil Rights Under Law](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142817314/658150127/123576536?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIwYTk0YTVmLTk3ZDctZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTU0NDQyZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pHf1kAJYN2WmusUsJOr-60zwTdxptEtN33fLa9pWV88=&emci=51f62a04-92d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&emdi=b0a94a5f-97d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&ceid=33603084)** by calling **1-866-OUR-VOTE**.

We can do this, folks -- we can defend our right to vote, make every vote count, and make the people heard in our elections. Whether you still need to vote today or are done until the next election, make sure your votes counts, your voice is heard, and that you forward this to your friends, family, and neighbors and make sure they have a plan to vote, too!

**Tuesday, November 3, 2026**

Sprayer bottles are as well used as sponges in my household. I keep a few empty ones in storage because, as anyone who makes good use of sprayer bottles knows, the sprayer always breaks long before the bottle.
So I am left with a collection of plastic bottles without sprayers. I save them just in case, but just-in-case never comes.
Whenever I come across my stash, I wonder: Why do they not make sprayers that last as long as the bottles?
Before my frustration lasts longer than five seconds, however, I remind myself that it is not all about me. Or the hundreds of thousands of other people who, at some point today, will come across their own just-in-case stash of empty plastic bottles.

**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.

Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

body:
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=1264%2E127862%2E8ow_6g)
Folks, it’s Election Day.
Today, Nevada families get to decide what kind of state we want to live in. [_**If you haven’t voted yet, find your polling place and make a plan right now:**_](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/240?t=3&akid=1264%2E127862%2E8ow_6g)
**[Visit iwillvote.com ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/240?t=4&akid=1264%2E127862%2E8ow_6g)**
I know how close races get here. In 2018, I won my race for Attorney General by less than half a percent. Every vote mattered then, and every vote matters today.
So please, **go vote.** Bring your partner, your neighbor, your coworker. And if you’ve already voted, thank you. Help me get one more person to the polls today.
Thank you so much,
Aaron
It's Election Day! [**Make a plan to vote before polls close at 7 PM.**](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/225?t=5&akid=1264%2E127862%2E8ow_6g)

name: Brandon Gill
subject: My last message before our country changes forever
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brandon Gill for Texas
body:
The next time you hear from me America will be different, for better or for worse

| |
---
|
---

This is the day we get to stand up for the values that made America the greatest nation on Earth - faith, family, freedom, and hard work. Every vote matters as we fight to secure the Congressional Majority and protect the country we cherish.
_Whether you’re at the polls right now casting your ballot, heading there in a few hours, or you’ve already voted up and down the ballot for our party, I wanted to take a moment on this critical day to thank you personally. As a small token of my appreciation, I have a special Election Day surprise gift I would like to send directly to my supporters. **_[Please, confirm your address here:>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
Please consider this my way of saying thank you for standing with me when our country needs it the most.
[CONFIRM ADDRESS](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
**_[I would also deeply appreciate it if you chipped in any amount: it can be SMALL or very GENEROUS — to help us finish strong today and deliver MASSIVE LANDSLIDE WINS to the Republican Party.>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
With faith in God and love for this great country, we will continue the fight to protect the America we cherish.
**God bless you and your family,**

Sincerely,
Donald J. Trump

On January 12, 1865, twenty Black ministers sat down with General William T. Sherman at his Savannah headquarters -- men who had followed his army out of slavery and were camped by the tens of thousands along the Sea Islands. Asked what independence required, their spokesman, the Rev. Garrison Frazier, gave the record its cleanest sentence: "The way we can best take care of ourselves is to have land, and turn in and till it by our own labor." Four days later Sherman signed Special Field Order No. 15 -- the islands from Charleston south, the abandoned rice fields running thirty miles inland, the country along the St. Johns River on the Florida line. Roughly 400,000 acres, reserved for freed families in plots of not more than forty acres. Mostly Georgia's coast. Over the following months, some 40,000 freed people received possessory titles.
The mule never appears in the order; it arrived later, in soldiers' stories of animals handed to the families who worked them. And the titles were possessory -- Army-protected until Congress settled ownership. Still, the plan ran through Lincoln. In late March, at City Point, Sherman briefed him on the settlement and Lincoln lent his assent; historians argue over whether he ever meant outright deeds, but he raised no objection. By mid-April he was dead.

The Reparations Republicans gave and a Democrat Revoked and Democrats Now Fight Over | | | Nov 3| | | ∙| | Preview ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | On January 12, 1865, twenty Black ministers sat down with General William T. Sherman at his Savannah headquarters -- men who had followed his army out of slavery and were camped by the tens of thousands along the Sea Islands. Asked what independence required, their spokesman, the Rev. Garrison Frazier, gave the record its cleanest sentence: "The way we can best take care of ourselves is to have land, and turn in and till it by our own labor." Four days later Sherman signed Special Field Order No. 15 -- the islands from Charleston south, the abandoned rice fields running thirty miles inland, the country along the St. Johns River on the Florida line. Roughly 400,000 acres, reserved for freed families in plots of not more than forty acres. Mostly Georgia's coast. Over the following months, some 40,000 freed people received possessory titles. The mule never appears in the order; it arrived later, in soldiers' stories of animals handed to the families who worked them. And the titles were possessory -- Army-protected until Congress settled ownership. Still, the plan ran through Lincoln. In late March, at City Point, Sherman briefed him on the settlement and Lincoln lent his assent; historians argue over whether he ever meant outright deeds, but he raised no objection. By mid-April he was dead. | | ---|---|--- Continue reading this post for free in the Substack app | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Heartland Journal 99 E. Main Street, Franklin, TN 37064 ? ?

Please remind your family, friends, and neighbors that the polls are open and encourage them to vote for Tom Tiffany and David Varnam. Every vote matters. name: Dr. Shirley Weber
subject: Election Day Reminder: Go vote!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shirley Weber for Secretary of State 2026
body:
https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper [https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper]
Dear friends,

Today is Election Day, and I urge every eligible Californian to either return their ballot at a drop-box or find a polling place [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/polling-place] to vote in person.

As a child, Election Day was a special day for me. As a little girl, my mother opened our living room as a polling place – a reminder that democracy is not a spectator sport.

Today is Election Day. And your polling place is open. Exercise your right to vote, and cast your ballot.

You have a right to vote, even if you still need to register to vote or update your voter registration. If you’re unsure whether you’re registered to vote, or you’re not sure if you’ve updated your voter registration since you moved or changed your name, you can still conditionally register and vote at your polling place on Election Day [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/polling-place/] .

As Secretary of State, I’ve overseen voter registration drives and higher turnout than ever before. I’ve fought to protect poll workers from violent extremists. And I’ve been a transparent leader because trust is everything .

I want every eligible Californian to be able to vote whether or not I agree with you politically. And I’ll fight like hell to make sure that nothing stands between you and the ballot box .

Onward,

Dr. Shirley N. Weber

This is it, folks.
Everything we've worked towards comes down to today -- Election Day. Polls are officially open across Maine, and before I say anything else, I need to ask for your help:
**[Will you please give $15 right now to help me get every possible supporter to the polls and defeat Susan Collins? I launched a $150,000 Election Day turnout goal, and we don't have a minute to waste in hitting it.](https://substack.com/redirect/5e080c3b-bc7a-41c0-b9d2-37a610ea0d05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[HELP ME DEFEAT SUSAN COLLINS TODAY ->](https://substack.com/redirect/5e080c3b-bc7a-41c0-b9d2-37a610ea0d05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Look, I've spent a lot of my time in the Northern Woods of Maine as a logger. I learned that tough jobs aren't finished when you're tired - you keep pushing until you get the job done.
That's exactly how I view today.
My campaign has spent months traveling across the state, talking with Mainers about what matters most to them: lowering everyday costs, rooting out corruption, holding government officials accountable, and ending the pay-for-play scheme in Washington are some of the most common answers.
### **I can tell you confidently that Susan Collins represents the exact opposite.**
Still, poll after poll has shown me tied with Susan. We're running in the closest Senate race in the country, so we can't afford to kick our feet up on the final day and leave conversations unfinished with undecided voters.
That's why our campaign has mobilized a massive organizing team to knock on doors, make phone calls, and help voters get to the polls. We need to make sure they have the support and materials they need to get the job done.
Our team has spent down to $0, so our $150,000 voter turnout fund will do exactly that.

Everything we've worked towards comes down to today -- Election Day. I learned that tough jobs aren't finished when you're tired - you keep pushing until you get the job done. That's exactly how I view today. My campaign has spent months traveling across the state, talking with Mainers about what matters most to them: lowering everyday costs, rooting out corruption, holding government officials accountable, and ending the pay-for-play scheme in Washington are some of the most common answers. We're running in the closest Senate race in the country, so we can't afford to kick our feet up on the final day and leave conversations unfinished with undecided voters. subject: My deepest gratitude
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=3254%2E5691347%2Ed5anwW)

Peter,
Almost six years ago, millions of Georgians cast their ballots and sent me to the U.S. Senate for the first time.
It has been a deep honor to serve the people of Georgia during my first term. Thank you for your support.
But now Election Day is once again upon us, and what happens here in Georgia today really, really matters.
Not just for Georgia, but for the whole country. And not just in the short term, but for decades to come.
Not for the sake of my career, and not for the sake of the Democratic Party, _but for the sake of our country:_ Today matters an awful lot.
[**So I’m asking you, one last time before polls close, please chip in to my reelection campaign. We can’t wake up tomorrow wishing we had done more.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-nov26.ijcilw&refcode=em261103-4-subs&utm_campaign=em261103-4-subs&t=2&akid=3254%2E5691347%2Ed5anwW)
Consider all of the damage Trump has done in just two years as president.
Only by regaining Congressional power can we reverse this. The only solution is victory.
We have to rebuke the crook President Donald Trump with such clarity and power that no president will dare such abuses again for centuries.
That's the opportunity we have today. And that will be a great service to our Republic.
[**So if sending an unmistakable message about what Georgia stands for and sending me back to the U.S. Senate matters to you, please, join me and donate $5 today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-nov26.ijcilw&refcode=em261103-4-subs&utm_campaign=em261103-4-subs&amount=5&t=3&akid=3254%2E5691347%2Ed5anwW)
Thank you for your support thus far and more soon,
Jon

body:
You showed up, and it mattered. Thank you for all the work you’ve done for our conservative candidates this year.

| | | | [](https://trk.email.tedcruz._qZ2h4mcQCywekcxZOw)
---
| | | Fellow Conservative, Before another minute goes by, I want to say two words: _THANK_ _YOU_! Today, patriots across this country knocked doors, made calls, sent texts, drove neighbors to the polls, and chipped in what they could to help conservative candidates cross the finish line. **You showed up,_and it mattered._** I wasn't on the ballot this year. But I spent these final weeks in battleground states, from Michigan to South Carolina to Alaska to Georgia and our great state of Texas, because I believe this election was every bit as important as my own. Our Senate majority, our House, our governors' mansions, and our state legislatures all hang together. If we want to secure the border, protect the Second Amendment, defend life, rein in reckless spending, and confirm judges who follow the Constitution, we need the whole ticket. **Not just one race.__Every race_._** That's why I went. And that's why your generous support meant so much to me personally. Every dollar you gave and every hour you volunteered went into protecting the conservative values that make this country exceptional. _Whatever the final tallies show in the coming hours and days, know this: the left did not out-work us this cycle. You saw to that._ I am deeply grateful for you. Get some rest. [**Tomorrow, the fight for America continues**](https://trk.email.tedcruz.), and I'm proud to have you in it with me. God bless,
---

Ted Cruz

# **Somali community members describe fear, threats and violence for voicing criticism of Ilhan Omar**
Several sources **[told The NY Post](https://substack.com/redirect/7af1a315-4538-44ab-b574-7b9247de845e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** they've faced threats, online harassment, and in some cases physical assaults after speaking publicly about Rep. Ilhan Omar.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7af1a315-4538-44ab-b574-7b9247de845e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **One source described receiving a threatening phone call urging him to recant past statements** and instead publicly support Omar ahead of the midterms, while another said a man based in Somalia threatened to have him hospitalized over negative comments he made toward the congresswoman.
* **Another member of the Somali community who had spoken critically about Omar was assaulted in Minneapolis and again outside a restaurant in Kenya in 2022.** He said he was ambushed by a group of around 15 people and pepper-sprayed, then knocked to the ground and beaten -- left with a concussion. He believes a popular Somali TikTok influencer incited the attack claiming the influencer "set his followers" on him in retaliation for criticizing Omar.
* **The scrutiny stems partly from long-standing allegations that Omar 's 2009 marriage to Ahmed Nur Said Elmi,** reportedly her brother, was fraudulent for immigration purposes -- claims she has repeatedly denied.

# **Trump announces end to US military aid to Israel**
President Donald Trump said U.S. military and financial assistance to Israel, roughly $4 billion annually, **[will end at year's close,](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce1c5ce-3806-48d8-b7f3-cd7192f6ff7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** explaining that Israel is thriving and no longer needs the support, which it can replace by purchasing weapons directly.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce1c5ce-3806-48d8-b7f3-cd7192f6ff7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump said Netanyahu himself proposed phasing out the aid after years of discussion,** framing the decision as mutual rather than one-sided, while noting Israel remains free to buy U.S. weapons going forward.
* **Trump acknowledged the political timing, tying the announcement to Michigan 's Senate race,** where Democrat Abdul El-Sayed has criticized Israel aid, while also linking the move to his broader push to reduce federal spending and balance the budget.

clean_body: | Friend, This is it. Today is election day, polls are open across Tennessee, and everything we’ve worked for all these months comes down to today. Today, Tennessee will decide whether we take our state back or let big corporations and billionaires keep calling the shots. I am asking for your vote today to elect the first woman governor in Tennessee history. We didn't dive across all 95 counties, pack 250 in-person stops , and spend months building this grassroots movement just to buy another four years for out of touch politicians who keep selling us out. This is our last, best chance to stand up for the people who actually live and work here. Let’s be very clear about the choice on the ballot today: WE ARE VOTING FOR: Ending the regressive grocery tax to put money back in your pocket, fully funding local neighborhood public schools instead of private voucher schemes, legalizing cannabis to rebuild our roads and infrustructure, expanding Medicaid to protect our neigbors and save rural hospitals, and bringing leadership to Nashville that will actually listen to working Tennesseans and put families over billionaires WE ARE VOTING TO DEFEAT: Out-of-state billionaire interests and corporate tax loopholes, private school voucher schemes that strip money from local classrooms, unchecked tech data centers that jack up power bills and exploit our natural environment, and state contracts with for-profit prison companies and healthcare monopolies. Marsha Blackburn and her billionaire backers have counted on working families sitting home and staying quiet. Today, we prove them wrong. Don't sit this one out. | | What if the greatest threats to our children’s future aren’t always the ones we can see? name: The Democrats
subject: When we say we’re running out of time, we mean it
body:
We can’t take a single thing for granted [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10224%2E22930333%2E6qUUzO)
---
Derek, **In an hour, polls will begin to close in battleground races.** So when we say we’re running out of time to reach the voters who will decide control of the House and Senate,_we’re dead serious._ **We have less than 60 minutes to get voters in line for the polls in Georgia.** 90 in North Carolina and Ohio. Two hours in Michigan, Maine, Mississippi, and Texas. 3 hours in Iowa. Six in Alaska. Derek, we can’t sit back and watch the results roll in yet. We can’t take a single thing for granted, and we won’t rest until the final race is called.**If you’re feeling antsy or nervous,_believe us, we get it._ But right now, we’re asking you to channel those feelings into action.** **There are voters in battleground states and districts across the country _right now_ who aren’t sure if they’re going to vote tonight. It’s _not_ too late for us to reach them and convince them to get in line. But we have to do it now.** Derek, this is the last time we’ll ask you for your support before the polls close and results begin to roll in. In just a few hours, every ballot will be cast. It’ll be a waiting game. **Thank you for staying engaged and supporting Democrats this year.** Our records show that you haven’t given yet. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make a contribution, _this is your last chance to do that before polls close._ So we’re asking: [**Can you chip in $7 to the DNC before the polls close? # Iran
* **U.S. strikes Iran 's Qeshm Island:** The U.S. [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/4ac0a331-1a76-4386-a684-97f6ab3b1f92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday as part of a series of unannounced attacks conducted in recent weeks, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing U.S. officials. The officials described the operations as defensive, claiming that Iranian forces had fired a surface-to-air missile at a U.S. fighter jet and launched another missile toward commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
* Washington has deliberately kept quiet about the strikes to avoid signaling a return to major combat operations, one official said.
* The revelations contradict President Donald Trump's public portrayal of the conflict as largely dormant. "We haven't been doing any fighting for months," he told reporters on Monday. He also denied plans to attack Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections.
* Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said on Tuesday that Tehran retains the right to self-defense until U.S. military attacks end "completely and permanently." The Israeli military denied involvement in the reported strikes.
* **U.S. and Iran far from peace deal; Qatar intensifies mediation ahead of midterms:** Iran and the United States [remain](https://substack.com/redirect/049c39ad-775e-40ce-8a3f-7f42d5252503?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) far apart on an agreement to end their war, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Tuesday, as Qatar intensified mediation efforts to prevent renewed escalation after the U.S. midterm elections. Qatari mediators traveled to Tehran on Monday night to discuss a revised proposal, with both sides expected to respond within 36 hours.
* Qatar's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Majed al-Ansari said that both countries were reviewing the proposal. "If there were no glimmer of hope, there would be no negotiations," he said, adding that "as a mediator, we cannot lose hope."
* Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf [said](https://substack.com/redirect/95422d85-e862-47ce-a83e-6ca33ecae6b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Tehran had delivered a "strong, rational response" to Washington. "The ball is now in Washington's court," he said.
* Meanwhile, Trump [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/9ce24d06-8133-41f8-a613-ea7307166817?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Iran wanted a settlement "as soon as possible," and suggested a deal "could happen," even as he threatened to strike Iran's suspected nuclear facility at Pickaxe Mountain "in one hour." Vice President JD Vance said that U.S. negotiators engaged Iran in "a number of good conversations," adding that he felt "pretty good about the prospects" of reaching a negotiated settlement.
* **IRGC claims capture of two U.S. spy drones over Qeshm Island:** Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) [said](https://substack.com/redirect/43e7c1ba-3c10-4847-b2eb-0a81c2c2d014?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Tuesday that its Aerospace Force brought down two U.S. MQM-170 reconnaissance drones over the southern island of Qeshm Island. To date, the IRGC claims to have captured four U.S. drones of this type.
* **Three oil tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz; Indian sailor killed in separate ship attack:** Three oil tankers [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/078b48e2-3a37-4b95-8d93-81931d855536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) naval mines and caught fire while traveling through unauthorized routes in the Strait of Hormuz, the IRGC said on Tuesday. The IRGC claimed that the vessels had switched off their identification systems before entering "restricted" waters, triggering explosions that left them burning along the strait's southern shores.
* Separately, on Monday, an Indian sailor was killed when the Indian-flagged cargo vessel MSV Al Jusufi came under attack near Limah, off Oman's coast. India's Shipping Minister [said](https://substack.com/redirect/250fc9b8-89ed-4c82-8860-02e81cc38ab5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the remaining 13 crew members were rescued by the Omani Coast Guard. No actor has claimed responsibility for the attack.
* **Talks with Saudi Arabia continue, Iran 's Araghchi says, calling for regional security without foreign forces: **Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on Tuesday that Tehran harbors no hostility toward Gulf Cooperation Council countries, and that it seeks new regional security arrangements led by countries in the region, without foreign military involvement.
* In a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/763db307-9bd5-435f-9151-1864744c0d20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X referencing his interview with Al Jazeera, Araghchi praised the "positive role" played by Qatar and Oman, and said that Iran continues its dialogue with Saudi Arabia. "Our goal is to reach new regional security arrangements established by the countries of the region themselves, away from any foreign military presence," he wrote.

# Palestine
* **Four Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza:** An Israeli drone strike on a police post near the College of Applied Sciences, west of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/b40f403d-1035-4657-bd97-4420dd414a1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) three Palestinians and wounded several others on Tuesday, WAFA reported. One police officer was among those killed in the attack, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/dec9e957-51c6-42b7-a401-31a4a050433a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Interior Ministry in Gaza. The ministry condemned the strike, saying that it was part of ongoing Israeli attacks on police and security forces in Gaza. Separately, a man died of wounds sustained in an earlier strike northwest of Khan Younis.
* Over the past 24 hours, Israeli attacks killed six Palestinians--five due to new attacks, and one due to wounds sustained in an earlier attack--and injured 27 others across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023, has risen to 74,615 killed and 175,899 injured. Since October 11, 2025, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,599 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 5,774, while 847 bodies have been recovered.
* **Exclusive: Israel orders complete closure of Gaza crossing with Egypt, blocking aid and commercial goods:** Israel informed the UN and Egyptian committee on Monday evening that it is imposing a "complete and comprehensive closure" of the Rafah crossing, blocking humanitarian aid, commercial shipments, food, fuel, and cooking gas entering Gaza through the Egyptian route, a senior Palestinian source involved in negotiations told Drop Site News.
* Israel claimed that alleged smuggling and "interference by government bodies in the Gaza Strip" were the reasons for the closure, the source said.
* The Egyptian route handles approximately 50 to 60 trucks daily, the source said, adding that "fuel and gas come entirely through this route."
* Under the October 2025 ceasefire agreement, 600 aid trucks are supposed to enter Gaza daily, but Israel has severely restricted deliveries, allowing an average of only around 200 trucks per day.
* The closure comes as Palestinians across Gaza face the onset of winter in makeshift tents and heavily damaged homes, with worsening food insecurity compounded by cuts to UN food assistance and rising prices. **Read Abdel Qader Sabbah 's report on the dire conditions in Gaza for Drop Site [here](https://substack.com/redirect/1e198c08-e31b-4ad6-bbfa-e781300debd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* **In Gaza, 42% of essential medicines, 50% of medical supplies depleted:** Forty-two percent of essential medicines and 50% of medical supplies are completely out of stock, Gaza's Health Ministry said on Tuesday, bringing critical healthcare services closer to total collapse.
* The depletion of chemotherapy drugs, hormonal treatments, immunosuppressants, and clotting factors disrupted 55% of treatment protocols for thousands of patients, the ministry said, exposing them to life-threatening complications as Israeli restrictions obstruct treatment outside Gaza.
* **Israel orders seizure of 11 acres of Palestinian land in occupied West Bank:** Israeli authorities issued military orders to seize approximately 45 dunams (11 acres) of Palestinian land across the occupied West Bank.
* In the northern Jordan Valley, Israeli forces [ordered](https://substack.com/redirect/fea14930-f77a-4367-8225-cc3f2f9a1d27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the seizure of seven dunams in Khirbet Al-Hadidiya to construct a military road, following earlier land seizures and the establishment of a settlement outpost in the area.
* In Jenin, two orders dated October 28 [target](https://substack.com/redirect/d7cda8cf-2dbc-4194-aaa8-acbde29328bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 11.2 dunams in Deir Abu Daif and Qabatiya to construct roads and buffer zones around the Ganim and Kadim settlements, which Israel reestablished this year after evacuating them in 2005.
* Near Ramallah, another order [targets](https://substack.com/redirect/ccb40e6c-d8a6-4d52-b90c-4e962706503f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 26.5 dunams in Deir Nizam, Umm Safa, and Atara for a road linking settlements.
* The orders, which remain in effect until the end of 2028, would expand Israeli military control, restrict Palestinian access to agricultural land, and strengthen infrastructure connecting Israeli settlements, the Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said.
* **Israeli forces demolish shops as settlers torch property across West Bank:**
* **Hebron:** Israeli forces [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/6ce967a1-d93b-42db-80ed-503c6407c0be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) five shops belonging to a Palestinian resident, northwest of Hebron, on Tuesday, WAFA reported. Forces also [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/4dc06e5e-f681-412f-bfe1-9a4baeb88126?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Al Jazeera correspondent Muntaser Nassar and more than 20 Palestinians during raids in Dura, reportedly binding and mistreating them before releasing them.
* In Yatta, south of Hebron, Israeli settlers set fire to two vehicles, an agricultural storage room, and a house under construction, and spray-painted racist slogans.
* **Bethlehem:** Israeli forces [assaulted](https://substack.com/redirect/174b2332-3085-4d17-b60e-a0ccaa9c8acf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Palestinians harvesting olives in Khalayel Al-Louz, southeast of Bethlehem, and prevented them from continuing their harvest.
* **Nablus:** Israeli settlers [severely beat](https://substack.com/redirect/319dcc78-f7d4-4807-88eb-c4f8a3703aa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a 60-year-old Palestinian man in Burqa, northwest of Nablus, leaving him hospitalized. In Majdal Bani Fadel, south of Nablus, settlers set fire to two vehicles parked outside Palestinian homes.
* **Ramallah and Al-Bireh:** Israeli forces [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/5f8d2be6-3c47-45a1-8d0c-cd076a7216a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Luay Nawaf, head of the Ein Yabrud village council, after raiding his home east of Ramallah.

# Yemen
* **Saudi coalition says it intercepted drone over Mecca; Ansarallah denies launching attack:** The Saudi-led coalition [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/1e8187f7-a6a2-49de-adcc-1e47b17c736d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Tuesday that it intercepted a drone over the Mecca region. Ansarallah military spokesperson Yahya Saree denied that Yemeni forces had carried out any operations targeting Saudi territory that day, accusing Riyadh of fabricating the incident.
* Saree [called](https://substack.com/redirect/545f73f9-7a73-41c8-aa62-a2c406ac52c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the allegation that the Ansarallah had targeted the Islamic holy city of Mecca "an old lie revived," claiming Saudi Arabia was attempting to distract from battlefield defeats.
* **Saudi strikes kill 17 civilians; Ansarallah strike kills five civilians at health center:** Saudi airstrikes killed 17 civilians over two days, most of them children, Sana'a Health Ministry said on Tuesday, accusing Saudi forces of targeting homes, residential neighborhoods, and markets.
* Separately, an Ansarallah ballistic missile struck Al-Saqiyah Health Center in Lahj province on Monday, killing five people, including three medical workers, and wounding 15 others, according to Yemen's Saudi-backed government.
* **Saudi Aramco expands repeatedly attacked oil pipeline:** Saudi Arabia oil giant Aramco [began](https://substack.com/redirect/f1c4ab69-2c87-442c-84ff-7abfed436481?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) expanding its East-West crude pipeline and developing additional export routes to bypass the blockaded Strait of Hormuz, CEO Amin Nasser said on Tuesday. Saudi Arabia aims to increase pipeline export capacity to as much as 10 million barrels per day, up from the East-West pipeline's current capacity of 7 million. The key pipeline has been attacked several times since September, with Saudi Arabia blaming an Iraqi armed group for a strike and Ansarallah claiming responsibility for others.

# Lebanon
* **Israel again violates ceasefire in southern Lebanon:** Israeli forces launched multiple attacks across southern Lebanon on Tuesday, according to Lebanon's National News Agency.
* **Bint Jbeil:** Israeli forces [shelled](https://substack.com/redirect/f36c40c7-b2df-4827-b362-fc7799e7fa08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the outskirts of Bra'shit.
* **Nabatieh:** Israeli forces [set fire](https://substack.com/redirect/48862f13-963a-4c06-9599-7f8574ea9e31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to homes in Zawtar Al-Sharqiya, and carried out an airstrike on the outskirts of Kfartabnit.
* **Marjeyoun:** Israeli forces [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/84e750c2-e336-4eae-94ec-e4def21ec350?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an explosion in the town of Qantara, accompanied by machine-gun fire.
* **France investigating Israeli attack on Beirut apartment building as possible war crime:** Two judges in the crimes against humanity unit of the Paris Judicial Court were [appointed to investigate](https://substack.com/redirect/ce6bbf3f-d69a-49db-988a-fb11b3d73c44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an Israeli airstrike on a 12-story residential building in central Beirut on November 26, 2024, that killed seven civilians, including the parents of French-Lebanese artist Ali Cherri, AFP reported.
* Cherri, whose parents were 87 and 77, filed a complaint this year with the International Federation for Human Rights. His lawyer described the judicial investigation as a first involving alleged Israeli war crimes in Lebanon.
* "What happened to my parents is not an isolated case," Cherri told AFP. "I hope this investigation will help break the impunity enjoyed by Israeli officials responsible for attacks against civilians in Lebanon and Palestine."

# U.S. News
* **Midterm elections nationwide:** U.S. voters will head to the polls on Tuesday with control of both houses of Congress on the line and with several key Senate races - in Michigan, Texas, Kansas, Ohio, Iowa, Maine and Alaska -- garnering particular attention. Recent polling indicates that Democrats are likely to take over the House and are leading in most (if not all) contested Senate races. **Drop Site will be hosting a joint livestream with Breaking Points, available on both YouTube feeds; coverage begins at 6 p.m.[here](https://substack.com/redirect/bf714f12-0316-42dd-a566-e95313ef10f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* **The Guardian: ICE re-arrests immigrants who won release from detention:** The Guardian [found](https://substack.com/redirect/51259d1c-7e0a-4982-9cba-a04b81d3c450?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least 20 cases of immigrants who won their release from detention and were later detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Immigrants have filed more than 91,000 habeas petitions since January 2025, per [ProPublica](https://substack.com/redirect/84981eb9-36b3-4c87-ba7b-84bf8d618530?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), more than during the past three administrations combined. Attorneys link many re-detentions to the Trump administration's push for third-country deportations, with more than 25,000 people already sent to third countries.
* **Mamdani demands ICE stop using city property to stage operations:** New York City mayor **Zohran Mamdani** [demanded](https://substack.com/redirect/bcbe3268-17d1-4c4c-9b3c-d6f6119d25e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that ICE stop using city-owned lots during its enforcement actions. On Monday, the mayor's office sent a letter to Homeland Security Secretary **Markwayne Mullin** , acting ICE Director **David Venturella** , and New York ICE field office head **Kenneth Genalo** , saying "ICE has no right to use our property as a base for tearing families apart." The letter added, "if they keep coming back, we will see them in court." Mamdani's demand comes after ICE shot a man while he was in his car with his five-year-old son on October 8 in upper Manhattan.
* **Supreme Court rejects Trump administration attempt to force California to set aside 20,000 mail-in ballots:** On Monday, the Supreme Court [denied](https://substack.com/redirect/040c1484-e775-42fe-9e76-2493a50d40c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Trump administration's emergency application to set aside 20,000 mail-in ballots in California. The ruling was swift, coming hours after the administration filed an emergency request. The case follows the Justice Department's declaration in October that it had compiled a list of more than 20,000 likely noncitizen voters in California. That list appeared to be riddled with errors, according to California officials, with only 7,035 names carrying Los Angeles County addresses and others confirmed as U.S.-born citizens.
* **Judge dismisses DOJ 's case against Harvard: **Massachusetts U.S. District Judge **Myong Joun** [granted](https://substack.com/redirect/1eb83292-2cb7-4e20-a7ee-bb60df982926?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Harvard University's motion to dismiss the Justice Department's case against it. The DOJ had accused the university of withholding admissions data from investigators seeking to determine if it was in compliance with the Supreme Court's 2023 ban on affirmative action in admissions. The government failed to prove that it had tried to resolve the dispute with the school before suing it, the court found. Joun did not rule on the merits of the case, meaning that the government can reopen its complaint once it addresses procedural deficiencies.
* **Trump says he would consider preemptive pardons for Elon Musk, other allies:** In a New York Post interview released Monday, President Trump [called](https://substack.com/redirect/e3bdfa02-21bf-4221-9fbf-7d92e53ef1cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) supposed Democratic threats against **Elon Musk** , including arrest and nationalizing SpaceX, just "talk," but said "we just have to protect those people." Asked by columnist **Miranda Devine** about preemptive pardons for Musk and others, he said "I would if I needed to, sure," adding "I'd do it. I did it for J6," referring to clemency for more than 1,500 Capitol riot defendants. Democratic leaders have discussed investigating Musk's business practices, but have not called for his arrest. Musk, whose net worth hovers around $1 trillion, has spent nearly half a billion dollars on Republican candidates and groups during the 2026 midterms.
* **NYT: Trump administration preparing to scale back pregnancy-related workplace protections:** The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, under chair **Andrea Lucas** , [plans](https://substack.com/redirect/f8710d01-984a-434e-a1c1-e6f423416908?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to narrow work accommodations for pregnant workers, the New York Times reported. As early as this month, the EEOC could release a proposal that scants the implementation of the 2022 Pregnant Workers Fairness Act, which covers such worker protections as bathroom and water breaks, reprieve from heavy lifting, and time off for prenatal care. The law includes accommodations for "related medical conditions," such as abortions, fertility treatments, and care for endometriosis and menstruation.
* **FEMA directs disaster aid to Republican districts in California and Minnesota ahead of midterms** : On October 30, the Federal Emergency Management Agency [directed](https://substack.com/redirect/e96fe0d6-fe5c-44c5-aeb5-5d9994fcbbfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) tens of millions of dollars to several Los Angeles, Calif., churches and to projects in or near vulnerable GOP Rep. **David Valadao** 's Central Valley district, the Washington Sun reported. The same day, FEMA funded one Minnesota project, a road in Rockville in House Majority Whip **Tom Emmer** 's district. The funds were released after Valadao worked with Speaker **Mike Johnson** 's office to pressure the White House and Office of Management and Budget for funds, most of which will repair a water district in the San Joaquin Valley.
* **U.S. to remove South Africa, Rwanda from African trade program:** Trump informed Congress and the governments of South Africa and Rwanda that the two countries are being cut from the African Growth and Opportunity Act, U.S. Trade Representative **Jamieson Greer**[said](https://substack.com/redirect/9bb7fbbf-7ecb-49d5-824a-f1f291050a00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday. He said the countries were removed for reasons related to "barriers that undermine American trade and investment and practices that pose a threat to U.S. national security and foreign policy interests in the region." The Trump administration has accused South Africa, the program's top exporter, of "anti-white" policies, and criticized its stance on Israel and its ties with Iran. The U.S. sanctioned Rwanda's defense ministry last week over its support for the M23 rebel group in eastern Congo.
* **New York child is first to die of measles in the state in 30 years:** New York State health officials [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/0a0805b4-9689-43c2-85f2-94bbea686b9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday that a child in northern county of Lewis died after contracting measles. Gov. **Kathy Hochul** linked the death to Trump administration policies that she said eroded confidence in pediatric immunization. Lewis County recorded 15 measles cases by mid-October, all occurring in unvaccinated people. New York has recorded at least 178 cases this year, concentrated in about 10 upstate counties, with Amish communities particularly hard hit. Across the U.S. there have been 4,852 cases this year, more than double the number in 2025.

# Other International News
* **Exclusive: Al-Shabaab attack in Somalia kills four civilians:** Drop Site contributor Mohamed Gabobe**** reports that**** Al-Shabaab,**** an Islamist rebel group, killed four civilians in Somalia's semi-autonomous Puntland region last week, according to two security officials. The dead were identified as Ikran Jama, Naima Ahmed, Jama Said, and Salma Mohamed.
* On the morning of October 27, Al-Shabaab fighters fired mortar rounds toward Galgala, a town in the Al-Madow mountain range, killing four people. Puntland troops returned fire on the rebels' position, using anti-aircraft guns to repel the attack, the officials said.
* Just days before the attack, Puntland's President Said Abdullahi Deni announced that the regional government would be launching a military campaign to remove Al-Shabaab from the mountains of Al-Madow. The United Arab Emirates and the United States are backing Somali operations, Gabobe previously [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/2aa096c2-7c0a-4fc7-a4fb-1031cee88bc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Drop Site.
* **Exclusive: Turkish airstrikes against Al-Shabaab in Somalia kill two civilians:** In response to an Al-Shabaab attack on Somali government troops last week, Turkey launched strikes targeting the rebels' military vehicles, Somali security officials involved in joint operations with Turkey told Drop Site contributor [Mohamed Gabobe](https://substack.com/redirect/7ebf6a63-9e67-45a5-9482-ce3c8fafc2ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The strikes killed two civilians and sparked anti-Turkish protests.
* On October 26, Al-Shabaab ambushed Somali government forces outside the town of Lego, in the country's Lower Shabelle region. Al-Shabaab detonated car bombs before firing weapons at the troops. Security officials declined to provide a precise number of military casualties, but told Drop Site that a "substantial" number of troops are unaccounted for.
* Following Monday's ambush, Al-Shabaab seized multiple military vehicles belonging to the Somali government that had been donated by Turkey, according to the officials. Turkish aircraft located some of the captured vehicles the following day, they said, using GPS tracking systems installed in the vehicles.
* One of the captured vehicles was located in an area called Jameeco. Turkish aircraft launched an airstrike that destroyed the vehicle. A civilian, 28-year-old Ibrahim Iidow Suxaaye, was working on nearby farmland when he was struck by shrapnel and killed, according to the officials.
* Al-Shabaab fighters took another seized vehicle to the Waberi neighborhood in Burhakaba district, where they eventually abandoned it, the officials said. A group of civilians were filming a TikTok video near the vehicle when a Turkish airstrike struck the area, wounding 23-year-old Mohamed Hassan Osman, who later died from his wounds, the security officials said.
* **Russia attacks aid site, killing 31, and hospital, injuring 73:** Russian forces "directly struck a city clinical hospital" on Monday night, damaging its cardiology department and injuring 73 people, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy [said](https://substack.com/redirect/9de7b972-73e8-4fdf-8e28-ff3efb81935b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Russia also bombed an aid center in Zaporizhzhia, [killing](https://substack.com/redirect/f75293ba-61b4-41f5-89a4-afd7ca6a02ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 31 people. Overnight on Monday, Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles, and 59 cruise missiles, mainly targeting the power grid, leaving more than 180,000 people without power in Zhytomyr and prompting scheduled outages in Odessa.
* Also on Monday, a Ukrainian drone attack in Russia's Yaroslavl province [injured](https://substack.com/redirect/9de7b972-73e8-4fdf-8e28-ff3efb81935b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two workers at an oil refinery.
* **UK increases wait time for most foreign workers seeking permanent residency to 10 years:** Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/95763dd1-1b07-40f4-b1e7-8dfce34281e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) changes to the UK's immigration rules on Monday, tying eligibility for permanent residency to income. People earning over 50,000 pounds ($67,000) will be able to apply for permanent status after five years, and people earning over 125,000 pounds after three years. Others must wait 10 years to apply. Exemptions were carved out for care workers earning at least 25,000 pounds, and for refugees arriving by new "safe and legal routes." Anyone arriving by a small boat or any other "illegal method," Mahmood noted, will have to wait 30 years to apply. Applicants will also be disqualified if they have a criminal record, lack English language proficiency, owe debt to the UK government, or show fewer than three years of national insurance contributions.
* **Ebola death toll in central and eastern Africa tops 5,300; most cases in the Congo:** The latest Ebola outbreak in central and Eastern Africa has [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/85d52495-0471-4090-8e76-e7f481807664?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 5,376 people, according to the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Two deaths have occurred in Kenya and Uganda each. The other 5,372 deaths occurred within the Democratic Republic of the Congo. There have been about 10,444 infections total across the DRC, Uganda, and Kenya, according to data from the Africa CDC--putting the fatality rate above 50%. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain.
* **Attackers ambush police convoy in Nigeria, killing 8 personnel:** An attack on a police convoy in Nigeria's northeastern Zamfara state [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/83cffadc-5980-4e5e-9fbc-23f52d12b495?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least eight Nigerian security personnel,**** Reuters reported. The dead include five police officers and three members of the state-backed Community Protection Guard. Police also said the attackers, identified only as "bandits," seized five AK-47 rifles and abducted several members of the police convoy; the number and their location are unknown.
* **Northern Ethiopia conflict pushing health system toward collapse, WHO says:** The conflict between Tigrayan rebels and the government has killed several civilians in recent days and strained medical facilities,**** World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus [said](https://substack.com/redirect/19bd0fb8-86b4-4bab-a2d9-e20fbcf54a3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday. The fighting is pushing the healthcare system to the brink, he added. It is straining health care workers and medical supplies and services. Ghebreyesus warned that drone attacks and civilian casualties were becoming "more frequent" across Ethiopia. The WHO and other UN agencies are working to deliver supplies, he added, urging protection for civilians and health workers.
* **Rubio talks reforms with Venezuelan officials:** U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio [met](https://substack.com/redirect/174c472f-4761-468c-8713-339c826f133f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Venezuelan Foreign Minister Oliver Blanco on Monday, with a State Department readout from the meeting saying that Washington reaffirmed Trump's "three-phase plan for Venezuela: stabilization, economic recovery and political reconciliation, and democratic transition." Rubio and Blanco discussed a potential framework for "free, fair, and credible elections" in the country, the readout said. A date for elections has not been scheduled, despite public pressure from opposition figure Maria Corina Machado, and a promise by interim president Delcy Rodriguez to hold elections.
