Friend, there's a lot of noise out there right now. We can’t be distracted.
Some people would love for the last day of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes.
**I will not be distracted.** Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders.
* This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it.
* This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to “trickle down” while groceries, rent and healthcare slip further out of reach.
* And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan for decades.

Please don’t get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won’t.
Election Day is today. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. In 2024, the Senate race here came down to 20,217 votes.
**I’m told there's still time to put our final get-out-the-vote ads in front of Michigan voters, but only if we have the cash to run them right now.**

clean_body: Don’t get pulled into the noise | | | = Friend, there's a lot of noise out there right now. We can’t be distracted. Some people would love for the last day of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes. I will not be distracted. Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders. This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it. This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to “trickle down” while groceries, rent and healthcare slip further out of reach. And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan for decades. Please don’t get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won’t. Election Day is today. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. In 2024, the Senate race here came down to 20,217 votes. I’m told there's still time to put our final get-out-the-vote ads in front of Michigan voters, but only if we have the cash to run them right now. = | | = Let them have the drama. Let us earn the votes. body:
Election Day is finally here.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261103-1&t=1&akid=4230%2E587540%2Eq8pPiy)
Election Day is finally here, Peter!
There are two things I need you to hear:
If you haven’t voted yet, please make your plan to vote before polls close today. **[You can look up all the voting information you’ll need here.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5900?utm_source=em20261103-4230&t=2&akid=4230%2E587540%2Eq8pPiy)**
**Your vote is a powerful tool, and it’s important for us to show up and show out for our candidates right now. Many of their races will come down to a handful of votes, in a handful of counties._Yours could be one of them_.**
Already voted? THANK YOU! **Now text three friends and make sure they’ve voted too.**
This cycle, we’ve endorsed more candidates than we ever have — with many of them competing in Red-to-Blue races that are now within reach because of your support. body:
I have seen the internal data. Here is what it tells me heading into the final stretch.
---
| | |
---
| Patriot, I see data that most people never do. I see the internal polling. The fundraising numbers on both sides. The turnout models. The precinct-level data in every battleground state. And I want to be direct with you about what all of it tells me heading into the final stretch. We are in a strong position. But this majority is not safe. The margin of error in the races we need to hold is razor thin. Texas is close. Iowa is closer than it has been in a decade. North Carolina and Georgia are fights we cannot take for granted. And Chuck Schumer knows every one of those numbers as well as I do. [_**He has been building toward this moment since Election Night 2024. He has the money, the infrastructure, and the belief that this is his year. Patriot, the only thing standing between his plan and our majority is a verified, organized conservative base that refuses to sit this one subject: Thank you for this, truly

body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3879%2E251025%2EcuK4Vm ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3879%2E251025%2EcuK4Vm ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter, this
is one of the last emails I'll send you before polls close tonight.

Thank you for coming along on this journey with me.

We’ve come a long way together. When we started, many pundits and
establishment politicos said a guy named Abdul couldn't win. They said a
campaign that proudly refuses money from corporate PACs and AIPAC was
doomed. They thought we never stood a chance.

We didn’t let that faze us. We kept our message disciplined and
straightforward:

Get money out of politics,
Put more money in your pockets,
Pass Medicare for All.

We took that simple message to every corner of the state — holding over
700 events in over 150 cities. At times, our town halls would go for over
two hours because I wanted to make sure we answered every last question.

[ Abdul ]Abdul smiling with folks at a town hall

I still think about Ferndale, where y'all survived the insane heat in that
basement and still brought all the energy. Or Detroit, where we packed
both the standard venue and the overflow hall with people rallying for our
stellar Democratic ticket alongside President Barack Obama:

[ Abdul, ]Abdul, President Barack Obama, and Jocelyn Benson

And of course, I have to shout out our amazing local unions, coalition
groups, students, and volunteers who always raised their hand to support
our campaign.

[ Abdul ]Abdul taking a selfie with a big group of supporters

I could go on and on, but I’ll sum up what I’m feeling by saying I am so
incredibly proud of the movement we've built. It's bigger than me. It
belongs to the nurses, the autoworkers, and all of you who have invested
in our campaign.

We've already made history once. Tonight, I'm hopeful we'll make even
more.

I won't pretend it's in the bag, though. There are still thousands of
Michiganders who haven't voted yet, and our team is working around the
clock to reach as many of them as we can before polls close.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261103-4-ak.eNZc2m&amount=10&refcode=em20261103-3876&t=1004&akid=3879%2E251025%2EcuK4Vm ]If you can, please chip in $10 or any amount to help us
reach last-minute voters and finish strong.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261103-4-ak.eNZc2m&amount=10&refcode=em20261103-3876&t=1023&akid=3879%2E251025%2EcuK4Vm ]Donate $10 ››

With love, gratitude, and hope,

Abdul ❤️

Peter, we’ve got a massive Election Day today(!), so I’ll be brief. I just wanted to send a quick note to thank you for everything you’ve done to strengthen the fair maps movement. I’m so proud of how this team has pushed back against relentless waves of attacks on what’s normal, what’s fair, and what’s right when it comes to elections. **Republicans are waging a war against American democracy. But we’re the ones refusing to let them win it.** We fought back state by state to keep the GOP from manipulating enough maps to steal the midterms. We’re getting urgent voting reminders into the hands of as many people as possible before polls close. We’re racing to elect over 300 Democracy Defenders to state-level offices where they can block new gerrymanders, advance fair maps, and ensure equal access to the ballot box. Tonight, we'll know if we did enough to protect fairness in pivotal states across the country. I know we won't win every single race we’re competing in, but because of you, I believe we will have momentum at our backs. We are proving we can take on whatever they throw our way. We will not back down or go away quietly. We will fight back. Thank you, Biz John Bisognano
President

clean_body: I’m so proud of how this movement has fought back. | Peter, we’ve got a massive Election Day today(!), so I’ll be brief. I just wanted to send a quick note to thank you for everything you’ve done to strengthen the fair maps movement. I’m so proud of how this team has pushed back against relentless waves of attacks on what’s normal, what’s fair, and what’s right when it comes to elections. Republicans are waging a war against American democracy. But we’re the ones refusing to let them win it. We fought back state by state to keep the GOP from manipulating enough maps to steal the midterms. We’re getting urgent voting reminders into the hands of as many people as possible before polls close. We’re racing to elect over 300 Democracy Defenders to state-level offices where they can block new gerrymanders, advance fair maps, and ensure equal access to the ballot box. Tonight, we'll know if we did enough to protect fairness in pivotal states across the country. I know we won't win every single race we’re competing in, but because of you, I believe we will have momentum at our backs. We are proving we can take on whatever they throw our way. We will not back down or go away quietly. We will fight back. Thank you, Biz John Bisognano President National Democratic Redistricting Committee | Our work doesn’t end when the polls close. Republicans will immediately return to shady tactics like gerrymandering and voter suppression to try to undermine democracy. Especially now, we need to keep defending free and fair elections. Here’s the truth: We went all in to invest as much as possible in highly competitive, critical elections this year — because we need to elect Democracy Defenders across the country. I know you're as anxious as I am right now.
Here's what you can do today to alleviate some pre-election stress.
1. Make sure you've cast your vote.
2. Make sure you've reminded your friends, family, and coworkers to vote.
3. And if you still are feeling anxious about tonight's results, I have one final ask before polls close: **[Will you chip in anything you can to ensure we have the cash to fight until the polls close at 8 PM and after?->](https://substack.com/redirect/3745fd69-5cf3-4e35-81e4-35da5a83cf2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

[CHIP IN NOW ->](https://substack.com/redirect/3745fd69-5cf3-4e35-81e4-35da5a83cf2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**To win this race, we 've spent every last cent we had. **But in Maine, the results could take several days as Election Officials sort through our Ranked Choice Voting Ballots.
And we all know what Republicans love to do while democracy is working: spread misinformation, launch baseless legal battles, and cast doubt on the democratic system. We need resources to fight back if this race is close.
And all indicators show this race will come down to the wire.
[So folks, this is the last time I will ask: ](https://substack.com/redirect/3745fd69-5cf3-4e35-81e4-35da5a83cf2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Will you chip in anything you can to ensure we have the cash to fight until the polls close at 8 PM and after?->](https://substack.com/redirect/3745fd69-5cf3-4e35-81e4-35da5a83cf2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Solidarity forever,

name: Swing Left
subject: What a NIGHT! What’s next?
body:
[1]Swing LeftSwing Left

Hi there,

What a NIGHT.

Now that’s what we call a Democratic SWEEP! We won in red districts and
states we haven’t won in generations. We won over new voters, MAGA voters,
unlikely voters, and virtually every demographic group.

And tonight’s wins don’t just feel good. Robust Democratic control of
Congress means Democrats can provide a real check on the Trump
administration and start delivering real change for Americans.

Make no mistake. We won because of YOU. Your calls, your knocks, your
donations, your commitment to winning the highest impact races.

We have so much more to celebrate, and we’ll debrief together soon (more
on that later).

But as this amazing victory sets in, and we absorb the opportunity of the
moment we are in, we know this community will quickly ask the question:
what’s next?

Whether we feel ready for it or not, the presidential election begins
tonight.

The news networks and political pundits will cover the primaries and their
lead-up ad nauseam. We’ll all be pulled into different camps and have our
favorite candidates.

But Swing Left, ever since its founding in the aftermath of the 2016
election, doesn’t play favorites. That’s because we were united by one
goal: electing Democrats to defeat Donald Trump and end MAGA control.

Nearly 10 years later, we’re still working to make that a reality. And
after tonight’s results, we’ve never been closer.

We worked together all cycle to build the grassroots
infrastructure—including innovative canvassing methods and technology—to
help Democrats win competitive races not just in 2026, but in 2028 and
beyond. Now, we’re launching a new way to support the future Democratic
nominee in the presidential election: The Presidential Nominee Fund.

[ https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=2028-presidential-fund.OSiNSH&utm_source=ak&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=2028-presidential-fund&utm_content=20261103-3&refcode=ak_em_2028-presidential-fund_20261103-3&t=1001&akid=3399%2E1562180%2EkT89OI ]2028 Swing Left Presidential Nominee Fund 0 Give the eventual Democratic
presidential nominee a powerful head start in the general election. Donate
today.

While the 2028 Democratic presidential primary is underway, we’ll pool
grassroots funds to support the eventual nominee—and release them
immediately to whomever wins the nomination. It will provide a much-needed
infusion of cash at a critical moment—after an expensive primary and when
the general election begins.

[ https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=2028-presidential-fund.OSiNSH&amount=25&utm_source=ak&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=2028-presidential-fund&utm_content=20261103-3&refcode=ak_em_2028-presidential-fund_20261103-3&t=1003&akid=3399%2E1562180%2EkT89OI ]Before you go to bed tonight, make a $25 donation to help
the eventual Democratic Presidential nominee be prepared to run a strong,
united campaign—and then forward this email to a friend.

[ https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=2028-presidential-fund.OSiNSH&amount=25&utm_source=ak&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=2028-presidential-fund&utm_content=20261103-3&refcode=ak_em_2028-presidential-fund_20261103-3&t=1023&akid=3399%2E1562180%2EkT89OI ]Donate $25 »

In the coming days, we’ll share more analysis of the races won tonight,
the impact the Swing Left community had, and what happens next. For now,
we can sleep well knowing we gave 2026 our all, and it is paying off.

Thank you again for helping to make tonight possible, and stay tuned for
more soon.

— The Swing Left Team

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.swingleft.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=3399%2E1562180%2EkT89OI

While the 2028 Democratic presidential primary is underway, we’ll pool grassroots funds to support the eventual nominee—and release them immediately to whomever wins the nomination. It will provide a much-needed infusion of cash at a critical moment—after an expensive primary and when the general election begins. name: Mary Silva For Congress
subject: It's Election Day: Get your ballot to a drop box by 8 p.m.
body:
Friends, Today is the day. If your ballot is still sitting on the kitchen counter, now is the time to fill it out and get it in. One important thing: please take your ballot to an official ballot drop box today, not the mailbox. Your ballot only counts if it's postmarked today or in a drop box by 8 p.m. tonight. Ballots dropped in a blue USPS mailbox today may not get picked up and postmarked until tomorrow, and a late postmark means your vote won't be counted. Thousands of Washington ballots were thrown out for exactly this reason in recent elections. Don't let yours be one of them. Find your nearest drop box here: https://www.sos.wa.gov/elections/voters/voter-registration/drop-box-and-voting-center-locations Drop boxes close at 8 p.m. sharp, so don't wait until the last minute. No stamp needed. If you truly can't get to a drop box, go inside a post office before it closes and ask the clerk to hand-postmark your ballot at the counter. Don't just drop it in the slot. This race is going to come down to who shows up. Every single ballot matters, and yours could make the difference. And once you've voted, text three friends and make sure they've voted too. Thank you for everything you've done to get us here. Let's finish strong, Mary

name: Abdul for U.S. Senate
subject: It's Election Day, and nobody knows how this ends
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP05/1/73169/images/Screen%20Shot%202026-11-01%20at%204.52.18%20PM.png]

There's a lot of noise out there right now. We can’t be distracted.

Some people would love for the last days of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes.

I will not be distracted. Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders.

— This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it.

— This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to “trickle down” while groceries, rent, and healthcare slip further out of reach.

— And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan for decades.

Please don’t get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won’t.

Election Day is TODAY. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. In 2024, the Senate race here came down to 20,217 votes.

I’m told there's still time to put our final get-out-the-vote ads in front of Michigan voters, but only if we have the cash to run them right now.

Please split a donation of $25, $50, $100, or any amount right now to fund Equal Opportunity Now and our last get-out-the-vote ads before polls close in just a few hours. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-abdul]

Patriot,

Most of what we send you is strategy: states, numbers, the plan to win. This one is about why we do this work at all. And that starts with Charlie Kirk.

Charlie launched Turning Point in the shadows of the Obama re-election campaign headquarters in Chicago. He was 18 years old.

Every established political force on the Left and the Right tried to stop him.

They failed.

What Charlie started grew into what is **the most influential activist organization in modern American history**.

We were privileged to work with him and be a part of this movement.

We joined Charlie because we believed our mission was the only viable way to save this country. Charlie was willing to do what nobody else in the conservative movement would do. He went looking for young Americans who cared enough about this country to act, and he gave them a reason to fight.

Then came 2020...

Under President Biden, we saw corruption, weaponization of the government, and a government promoting values that put Americans last.

Charlie was adamant that we do everything we could possibly do to fix this in 2024. **We DID IT** , and we must continue for 2026 and 2028 to have a shot at saving this country.

Now, it is on us to continue Charlie's vision and mission.

Every single day, we work to continue his legacy of recruiting, training, and mobilizing a new generation of citizens who love this country enough to do something about it.

That work does not stop at the campus gates. It's now changing the direction of the nation.

Right now, ballot chasers supported by Turning Point PAC are in the field in **states that will determine not just 2026, but the 2028 Presidential election**.

They are meeting voters face to face. They are building real relationships in these communities. They are chasing every ballot, whether it's cast on Election Day or by mail.

This is how we build the Red Wall.

[Every $50 raised supports a ballot chaser for one full day in the field.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=fb3288fd351c4b0a905eee2932c9a872&_e=-gOSUFm1x6CQOXSCPBEaWYDCcvf98TOmigE5yQl8-RqQJj3c3wIeKLTU4iE5SI6FfvFAaAAQ2SzXL0LK3PltFvhb4QEdbm4BZvFbv0IHyCknHh_lwgMUZvNZIR7Dhav85u3LSzLQmeOFyaDbVjwo7J22ml6u2gOT8jrSviutgdHZ4TZmfmEbkix-j3kPjGQQS3AQMeBFHFbngXIZzc8pJw8d2VDfulESR7rhM_zX7Cx1cSNLQpFVvCdRmPtyQgHjPDjc1pqbPH5Y0mw2VZP1TN3jK1jvHXMtOAcZs7eYwmuwCkaz2qfF7pj65Dv2_54tvAY5N82J-CYHWiLhgpnJQN7igttdIW74okrOYrSCAt8J_4-JzVk1AjfQmvzIcxzvCJrv0QrL2Rtj9cwetPlo2Z7hR_17DVkY-LcQiahNZNk1GHdnKMobB4EP-DcJyc0mgn56RrF5NCxuBONx9E8uX4babj11wYI4twW9lNgTIUML4zSpNG51FvEtm3rGxrjhnilDTS1DcVLH-nREy9IXcnaM8yedswsZKBERcV4D5q26BzU1TCJVaSx3Gm4KbKLOxZSm27CpzVQKJq92c9FCGlcafRHgl79r76-FYo4rx5LWv4CazCbdFveJ2aszIKe1acu8FtPCmHbdBPCE-OMTXQ%3D%3D)

| 482 days. 8,000 volunteers. 140,000 doors. 500,000 phone calls. That's what it took to send a 29-year-old immigrant, barista, renter, recovering lawyer, and democratic socialist to the United States Congress.
Denver, YOU did this. Tonight belongs to you.
I want to thank my parents and sister, my aunties, uncles and cousins for supporting me and being a part of this campaign.
To Justice Democrats, Denver DSA, the Working Families Party, Sunrise, to every single union and organization that stood with this campaign: thank you. And to our organizing team -- the best a girl could ever ask for -- you just made history.
My parents came to Denver from Ethiopia in 1998 on a Diversity Visa lottery. I was 11 months old. My parents started over from scratch, and worked multiple jobs to put him through pharmacy school at CU Denver.
They picked Denver because they knew we'd be welcome here. Tonight, Denver proved them right. And that's the Denver I'm taking to Congress. A city where it doesn't matter if you've been here for decades or for days. Whether you crossed the border or the border crossed you. Whether you make $500k or $50k. You belong here and you deserve to live with dignity and opportunity.
Now I want to speak directly to the corporate lobbyists, and to every dark money group that hid its donors until the votes were counted: you spent millions trying to stop this.
In just this cycle, 20 people spent over 2 billion dollars in these midterm elections. Elon Musk alone spent nearly 500 million dollars. No one knows better than these billionaires how fragile this broken system they've created is. No one knows better than these billionaires how powerful we the people are when we organize. That's why they spend all this money trying to stop us.
They had organized money. We had organized people. And organized people beat organized money every single time.
Because our fight is righteous. We're fighting for a world where your paycheck actually covers your rent. Where a cancer diagnosis doesn't send you into bankruptcy. Where our immigrant neighbors don't have to live in fear of a rogue, deadly agency. Where our tax dollars are spent investing in our babies here at home, not bombing babies abroad. Where our elected officials represent their voters not their donors.
That means we need to pass a living wage for all, to pass Medicare for All, to abolish ICE, to end the endless, genocidal wars, and to finally get big money out of our politics.
That is what Denver voted for tonight. And I'm going to fight like hell for it.
And let me just say, to the other candidates in this race, who stepped up to do the same thing, thank you for running. Running is not easy, we need more people standing up and asking to serve, so thank you.
And for anyone who voted for these other candidates, we may not agree on everything, and in a healthy democracy, that's okay, but that won't stop me from fighting like hell for you. For you and your right to live freely and peacefully with dignity, regardless of your party, faith, ethnicity, gender, orientation, or status because the greatest lie ever told was that the freedom we're fighting for is scarce.
That freedom is so scarce that there's only so much of it to go around, and for some to hold it, others have to go without it. Freedom is not a fortune to be hoarded. It is a right that no one - no billionaire, no government - can take away from us. That is the great promise of this country, of the American dream. Not a dream that shrinks to fit the few, but one wide enough to hold all of us together, because it's only together that we can truly achieve true liberation and freedom.
This country belongs to everyone who loves what it stands for. The people born here and the people who just got here. Everyone who thinks democracy is worth defending and that every person deserves dignity.
It's because of this fight for our collective freedoms that we won tonight. This is a movement, one that follows a long line of dreamers and fighters and giants, whose shoulders we stand on tonight, and we're just getting started.
Thank you, Denver!
- Melat Kiros

Whether you crossed the border or the border crossed you. Whether you make $500k or $50k. You belong here and you deserve to live with dignity and opportunity. Now I want to speak directly to the corporate lobbyists, and to every dark money group that hid its donors until the votes were counted: you spent millions trying to stop this. In just this cycle, 20 people spent over 2 billion dollars in these midterm elections. Elon Musk alone spent nearly 500 million dollars. No one knows better than these billionaires how fragile this broken system they've created is. No one knows better than these billionaires how powerful we the people are when we organize. That's why they spend all this money trying to stop us. They had organized money. We had organized people. And organized people beat organized money every single time. Because our fight is righteous. We're fighting for a world where your paycheck actually covers your rent. Where a cancer diagnosis doesn't send you into bankruptcy. Where our immigrant neighbors don't have to live in fear of a rogue, deadly agency. Where our tax dollars are spent investing in our babies here at home, not bombing babies abroad. Where our elected officials represent their voters not their donors. That means we need to pass a living wage for all, to pass Medicare for All, to abolish ICE, to end the endless, genocidal wars, and to finally get big money out of our politics. That is what Denver voted for tonight. And I'm going to fight like hell for it. And let me just say, to the other candidates in this race, who stepped up to do the same thing, thank you for running. Running is not easy, we need more people standing up and asking to serve, so thank you. And for anyone who voted for these other candidates, we may not agree on everything, and in a healthy democracy, that's okay, but that won't stop me from fighting like hell for you. For you and your right to live freely and peacefully with dignity, regardless of your party, faith, ethnicity, gender, orientation, or status because the greatest lie ever told was that the freedom we're fighting for is scarce. That freedom is so scarce that there's only so much of it to go around, and for some to hold it, others have to go without it. Freedom is not a fortune to be hoarded. It is a right that no one - no billionaire, no government - can take away from us. That is the great promise of this country, of the American dream. Not a dream that shrinks to fit the few, but one wide enough to hold all of us together, because it's only together that we can truly achieve true liberation and freedom. This country belongs to everyone who loves what it stands for. The people born here and the people who just got here. Everyone who thinks democracy is worth defending and that every person deserves dignity. It's because of this fight for our collective freedoms that we won tonight. This is a movement, one that follows a long line of dreamers and fighters and giants, whose shoulders we stand on tonight, and we're just getting started. Thank you, Denver! - Melat Kiros | | == | | == | | == | | | | Melat Kiros | PO Box 16134 | Denver, CO 80216 US | |

| | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.

My fellow Americans - it is Vice President JD Vance.
[This is a longer email, but I respectfully ask you to read it start to finish.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=b8080a88b8aa49a68cfd78d14964f936&_e=BNj5enFFLPVAiAjOAQG8g7ffy_ylbq6kMWHWj5b4oM1yR3onHQUSi9aFIFiUnS0zaHg7IOOJTGkjHH0MukrwnXDl0hnpljyBwTAG8aBHb6uPOAs-0U9kWC32kvLw1E1-ZXNzvePiZew5tuceM_mSPrYpdpsc0I9DyDjp7M0n_F-Enxl85Mx0JwlpmJZfemr33fov_s7-BupEmhTLUzFiqg8zM63QdYBLD8UrWZ2KU1QO6ii4eNoah6K0-5z1o2uyktOoz6R-FFvOoyhlI4R50kITfvRQBqVGcXJPfSs2_nAFouKAN2wg1TZWdAkhxRjp28BiUE9mGvppzelA261UK9ghEcYAF4V3TV7_l0YYZCO_kSGgP7qCz8M3OTLojqEO-mz6FKJHDNYaiQzSR7ZwykJ1rmQ7ZsLsAbms7QjYlh2hrPBKXXgx_ePGjilMqFPpGm2vBzoSoJZbJvjFbxp9PNOClY26GfZd-pckFXaIRySs0p_JFgc03sBsMQVcUQOBq-pszbWWddfwdi4MrbPlEyNsQZDCpQar9RNZGMLsoCFoZYzp7NSbcrcUpZmg3T7t21rFV_MjgBxB1x64pc6q6hpWqj16JeBgwjF4BN8U9Pc0l4j2w3k3x9D_SzZNHYK3lZY_9Zcri92bgBEgPYQtvvLv65ahXibWSvebNmkMV5me18pB3MKPPy5pYl86kfMnnTcQKaurQFWK4IJDdbkynIVQo0RQFDE8NmQ3BYBk2CJM4n0OwjD0ScDtjDAldqfF_Y7btMin5RzUl3u6Dr4tg9H-Yzy-fGoS2YGGWLP5_-s%3D)
It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.
It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.
I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you.
I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.
[Which brings me to the purpose of my email today.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=b8080a88b8aa49a68cfd78d14964f936&_e=BNj5enFFLPVAiAjOAQG8g7ffy_ylbq6kMWHWj5b4oM1yR3onHQUSi9aFIFiUnS0zaHg7IOOJTGkjHH0MukrwnXDl0hnpljyBwTAG8aBHb6uPOAs-0U9kWC32kvLw1E1-ZXNzvePiZew5tuceM_mSPrYpdpsc0I9DyDjp7M0n_F-Enxl85Mx0JwlpmJZfemr33fov_s7-BupEmhTLUzFiqg8zM63QdYBLD8UrWZ2KU1QO6ii4eNoah6K0-5z1o2uyktOoz6R-FFvOoyhlI4R50kITfvRQBqVGcXJPfSs2_nDllTpTF7hyW3LD9nUcDsYYXu8yZXgcUddAwpDV2KWdYn4OqZBO9AKCfjTYU2VExY3HlKbERNzwLo1n3iAXGQhRtwsemJlQyhp3UoanTRp7RixJY5WajclOYa3QecmMrdJx-q8HjAtY5do6GQJ6uhsyHEoaG1tiemeWbWfZigCetyyuyygsvbbrJ6pgeVtnHRH3aEkRStfE9IB8KbJnqYt3pzZ42zFD1mnN5Go2wRn1QXJHLp7bJCl8LzrP43alwVPzDt6d-OPwQe8nn7aas9rTcrCR0ulO3rj1ddGL5JyxSVZSDzJ6EVZ-7bIMEch_OqyBDJVTAh8dXVmySrosnGiOK2h21rH7GmFV57A5n-cKs6jq43W8_k3loWeI5M--TBsqwNprv4hBqsUtX2_PCPMozNaifKVU4PyeecUYIIiDEMtcWkNloCgyAL6XyZ32v4ZrD4xwRNGUbw_PoTn1Af1kv6tZPjKsT7_mkvKx5QXbIGhxaq3C5RAAYfIVjA3RGGc%3D)
We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win.
The Democrat Machine is crushing us in fundraising, outspending us in key races, and built the campaign infrastructure to decimate us tonight.
At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable.
So here's my final pitch to you:
[I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to raise a $10,000 before the polls close tonight.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=b8080a88b8aa49a68cfd78d14964f936&_e=BNj5enFFLPVAiAjOAQG8g7ffy_ylbq6kMWHWj5b4oM1yR3onHQUSi9aFIFiUnS0zaHg7IOOJTGkjHH0MukrwnXDl0hnpljyBwTAG8aBHb6uPOAs-0U9kWC32kvLw1E1-ZXNzvePiZew5tuceM_mSPrYpdpsc0I9DyDjp7M0n_F-Enxl85Mx0JwlpmJZfemr33fov_s7-BupEmhTLUzFiqg8zM63QdYBLD8UrWZ2KU1QO6ii4eNoah6K0-5z1o2uyktOoz6R-FFvOoyhlI4R50kITfvRQBqVGcXJPfSs2_nBV47Rw3KKoM27w9j9ng5757-aftbYI_NW237aJl_cG-Gn_u6bKLDhRn3uLR3Ldb4QyfVldCmVYrwhsBUEoYS8dLda198lJSLlQi23NWFGZITsWwsB5uAb3TnX-Iju-fYkTzqCCIg_La7a4n3uYHTJrRPW2dBCDsXr-mM781eSsCPFNY4SUFz33NP30dcb_p82j8iaEAo_-35LMi3oGnD1x9R_WSDobK_y0GII1bbTpIHCVx4IJnFZZlOEcw0kAwdUZksGo0_8bLwklaeWfUW_uFAzXb_-LY-IJ9jit2qAfPOgImE2GVr6ctWjw00Rggrud4dNJqQq8tjW2c5jWw3ZEtEh2prVOKozQRQPMEmaKuCWe91bDOTY4Rw_Em3I_FZXnfgvHaUq6gQhFRi3-mDLXSLwgRUb_EzUK2jUbGFuX8C4mLodmthwR8w7t-dz7pOkUd4YDYamVE_WLU1Y13ak2sQvoImX_EKHyeKz7q4PTXvoPTn5QInToOgS7JJyU7Jw%3D) I understand that's ambitious. clean_body: It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw, and that my mother was an addict | My fellow Americans - it is Vice President JD Vance. It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction. It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC. But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11. As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you. I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great. We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win. The Democrat Machine is crushing us in fundraising, outspending us in key races, and built the campaign infrastructure to decimate us tonight. At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable. So here's my final pitch to you: I understand that's ambitious. But if that's what it takes to deliver President Trump a Republican House for his entire second term, it's a no-brainer. I'll do what it takes to win. Do you think you can help us get there? Whether it's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up: | Look, you've probably heard bits and pieces of my story at this point. Hi there,
I wanted to write you one more time before the polls close tonight.
When we started this campaign, plenty of folks didn’t know my name. The forecasters had us as underdogs. We were going up against a sitting governor with a big war chest and special interests in his corner.
Today, we’re in a toss-up race, statistically tied, and in a real position to win.
That didn’t happen by accident. It happened because of y’all.
Whether you chipped in when money was tight, knocked doors, or told a friend about this campaign, you believed in this before a lot of other people did. **Thank you.**
Courage is contagious, and y’all have shown a whole lot of it.
With just a few hours left, our team is doing everything we can to reach every last voter. If you’re able, will you pitch in one more time to help us finish strong?

[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

As polling places prepare to close across the country, one thing is
becoming increasingly clear: Donald Trump is getting desperate. And a
desperate Trump is dangerous.

He and his cronies have been laying the groundwork to undermine the
results of this election for months. They’re repeating baseless claims
about widespread noncitizen voting. They’re threatening to prosecute
election officials, filing lawsuits to restrict the counting of disputed
ballots, and trying to interfere with the certification of results.

In Alaska, Trump's Justice Department has even sued to try to prevent the
state from certifying its Senate race if the Republican incumbent loses by
a narrow margin. And when asked whether the Justice Department might
intervene in state election certifications, Attorney General Todd Blanche
refused to rule it out.

This is happening before we even know who won.

We don't know what Trump will try next. But we know he's willing to use
every lever of power at his disposal to protect himself. That's why we
need to be ready.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39991?t=1011&akid=11550%2E5885482%2E2E2Mz0 ]SIGN THE PLEDGE: STAND READY TO MOBILIZE TO DEFEND OUR ELECTIONS.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39991?t=1013&akid=11550%2E5885482%2E2E2Mz0 ]Graphic reading: Sign the pledge to mobilize

The coming hours and days will be critical. Many states won't have
complete results tonight, especially in close races. Trump and his allies
could use those delays to manufacture suspicion, challenge legitimate
results, and pressure election officials not to do their jobs.

We cannot let them turn the ordinary process of counting every vote into
an excuse to attack our democracy.

The No Kings movement is already mobilizing. Together, we’re building a
powerful, nonviolent mass movement prepared to respond if Trump and his
allies try to interfere with the count, intimidate election officials, or
block the certification of legitimate results.

That means showing up, speaking out, organizing our communities, and
making clear that we will not stand by while politicians try to choose
which votes count.

We don't need to predict Trump's next move. We need to be ready for it.

If he tries to undermine this election, we will mobilize. If he tries to
stop the count, we will demand that every vote be counted. If he tries to
block certification, we will stand with the people responsible for
upholding the results.

When we organize, we win.

We cannot let them turn the ordinary process of counting every vote into an excuse to attack our democracy. The No Kings movement is already mobilizing. Together, we’re building a powerful, nonviolent mass movement prepared to respond if Trump and his allies try to interfere with the count, intimidate election officials, or block the certification of legitimate results. That means showing up, speaking out, organizing our communities, and making clear that we will not stand by while politicians try to choose which votes count. We don't need to predict Trump's next move. We need to be ready for it. If he tries to undermine this election, we will mobilize. If he tries to stop the count, we will demand that every vote be counted. If he tries to block certification, we will stand with the people responsible for upholding the results. clean_body: It's nice to meet you, Derek | | | | Hey there, my name is David Crowley, and I'm running to be the next Governor of Wisconsin. Allow me to reintroduce myself: I grew up in one of Milwaukee's poorest zip codes with working-class parents who both struggled with mental health and addiction. I know what hard work looks like. I'm a proud husband and father of three, and I know firsthand what it's like to stress over groceries, healthcare costs, and gas prices. Working families are always the first to feel it when costs go up. I've dedicated my career to public service, as a State Representative, as the Milwaukee County Executive, and soon as Governor. I will never stop fighting for our communities. I'm up against MAGA Congressman Tom Tiffany, who is backed by far-right billionaire families, and Election Day is TODAY. **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Tuesday, November 3, 2026 Contact: Maddy Rosen[](mailto:emilyhan@endcitizensunited.org) [maddy@caitconley.com](mailto:maddy@caitconley.com) [](mailto:maddy@caitconley.com) **
**
### CAIT CONLEY URGES VOTERS TO GET OUT AND VOTE: EVERY VOTE WILL BE COUNTED
__**************************************OSSINING, NY –** Today, Army combat veteran and Democratic nominee for New York’s 17th Congressional District Cait Conley urged Westchester voters not to be dissuaded by technical issues with ballot scanners at polling locations across the county. **The polls are open and operational; voters can cast their ballots easily, and every vote will be counted.** _“Nothing should stand between Westchester voters and their right to make their voice heard in this election. There are currently technical issues with ballot scanners, but we are closely monitoring the process to ensure that every Westchester vote is counted. The Board of Elections is working diligently, in a bipartisan manner, to resolve the issue. The polls are open and operational. Please stay in line, cast your ballot, and make your voice heard,” said_** _Democratic nominee for New York’s 17th Congressional District._** [__](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWwGamPY7W-vS4bGbFoLcGE_goybYzUFubWM_2Su_UtRTl_xccYCVHKiahBp4feLiT-bNSC_Gnr3pCN6aHU2aQjVyY4cl-fG4Ee52ccBHQnm8im7arD76JygldbgvatpUAHHK3P33PE1pzYWnahq3N6I99VX7VQEOJ6GPrtc9Iwc4wb8RaT8n6SXr_s_MtcT48Gol7qxq4PHaBYtNmZUOJvhBsICgPAoySYZA-cRuxtThjYlAeFYnU4JcAlLAYVfk1amEFxTJyIN4DliaolDuC_BF_4HTXeZQ3-koCwxH_TdIcN24TMu-uJg9nF0GqypnMHSqCRm68K9692B6URjjcgtGIEYyXDFVS9-gifLFyM6Ti3Y5YVabhGBmTN5MMJflD0PJGlC4BZsAjhCjASy2fzcEI5j_XI9aNhh--rMFYkT0b40eGD6n2cvFmpxC755L6nkv5fANhJHDYr1DqOaya4f4vbEC22ENAMkxogTZB-fj/4vf/UVbGSUM_TyyiBp4bGqQxZQ/h0/h001.xgdz4gkrb81elZ9kJoDU5jExPb9efw9wIjNDv6O0LgQ)____[****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.RNKlYhK-gnABEpCnH88uwMI5fgAJUrvlxUFs3GAvrZIzg2zpag-r0n8Hpx6ZhNAAMVL5G5Jd0_99apRtFXM3V_0FNSRvmkMJ5qM26SpFCfED4F1ewXTm3bJ2PLFwKnX-RMs8fytlVzUhI1MQLvstY1ha4FRL_U2mRLFm_UOO5IHHvnrluObDAnGrNARIflPNnh7cZU1G-EvE--vo9zl8E1VQFXpcCj_H5ihVyDB2IHMhnQEMbIk0cy2sKlQsBVlDBQGy5S2_0NsVVCcSZuiOA4wsBusmHZrVVzIHHctHUlQ1PosCxSGcLUnqnP0bHSo-Z3dBNUxPe0VNGTW2GUcfe8vJGPJJFdoFwXd19huBxjU/4vf/UVbGSUM_TyyiBp4bGqQxZQ/h1/h001.p9CCSTEqlqlN-rcWOKABeV-FYqinkAX0sPYnIrqD274)****__ ******** **** ### **About Cait Conley** Cait Conley is a Hudson Valley native, the daughter of a postal worker and a construction worker. Hey everybody,
I'm checking in with you tonight from Columbus, where I'm about to meet Connie, our children and grandchildren, Patrick my campaign manager, and other folks from my team to watch results come in.
Before we get into it, some important stuff:
**Polls close tonight in Ohio at 7:30 pm ET. If you are in line, stay in line.** You have a right to vote if you are in line at or before 7:30 pm.
There is a lot we will learn tonight, and __ we may not know the final result right away.
This isn't a bad thing. It means our election workers are counting every vote, including mail in, overseas, and absentee ballots.
Just this weekend alone, thousands of new volunteers signed up to talk to voters and get them the information they need to go out and vote. That's incredible. I'm so grateful.
You have been a huge support to me throughout the last 15 months.
I've held your stories close, and shared them. We've trained thousands of volunteers and nearly half a million people have made a donation to support this movement.
**Every single vote we earn tonight means something powerful.**
It means ordinary people believe we have the power to demand better. It means despite $320 million of Republican spending to attack me, Ohio voters didn't buy it. They know my opponent and the Republicans have nothing real to say to people who are hurting - the people they said they'd help.
Every vote for us means someone decided our communities matter more than the greed of a few billionaires. That our kids and families here are more valuable than their endless wars over there. That helping Ohio is more important than protecting the powerful.
I'm really proud of that -- I hope you are, too.
I'll be watching with you. More as soon as we know it.
In solidarity,
Sherrod Brown

Before you click away!
Our resources are zeroed out. We've allocated every dollar that came in the door to reach voters before polls close tonight. That means our accounts will be empty (or maybe even a little in the red). That's on purpose. **But it 's also taking a big risk.**
If the result is too close to call and Sherrod's fight continues beyond tonight, we won't have the resources we need to wage it. Outside groups have shown they're willing to spend ungodly sums to buy this seat. We can only expect they'll do the same with Senate control still on the line.

The Debt Just Passed

For U.S. savers age 55+ with $50,000 or more in an IRA, 401(k) or
savings. Free of charge, no obligation to buy anything.

SEND ME THE FREE GUIDE →
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

In August 2026 the national debt passed $40 trillion.1 It was not
voted on. There was no ceremony. Most Americans found out from a
headline, if they found out at all.

Somebody has to absorb it

A debt that size does not simply sit there. It gets serviced,
refinanced, and eventually dealt with — and there are only three
ways to deal with it: raise taxes, cut spending, or reduce the real
value of what is owed by letting the currency weaken. The first two
require Congress to do something unpopular on the record. The third
requires nobody to do anything at all.

That is why the figure matters to a retirement account rather than
just to a budget committee. Every dollar in your IRA is a claim
denominated in the same currency the debt is denominated in.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.
If the obligation is managed down in real terms, that happens through
your savings, not around them.

The evidence is already behind us. It takes roughly $1.95 today to
buy what a dollar bought in 2000.2 Nothing was confiscated. The unit
was simply worth less each year, and savers holding it carried the
